# Taskbar Audio Spectrum 1.1.0

Version 1.1.0 focuses on runtime reliability, Windows shell compatibility,
resource ownership, and clearer documentation for both supported editions.

## Highlights

- Correctly identifies the full taskbar Search box without treating the
  narrower Search icon-and-label button as an eligible overlay target
- Improves recovery after Explorer, Search, taskbar-layout, and audio-device
  changes
- Reduces unnecessary per-frame window, foreground, z-order, and audio work
- Suspends WASAPI capture when shell/display conditions make the overlay
  ineligible, including zero opacity
- Validates extensible PCM and IEEE-float audio formats with exact subtype GUID
  matching
- Handles long executable paths and malformed startup registry values safely
- Distinguishes a missing standalone configuration from a present but invalid
  or unreadable file
- Explicitly destroys the Windhawk runtime during normal mod unload
- Uses dynamically resolved DPI helpers with a stable 96-DPI compatibility
  fallback
- Expands automated coverage and rewrites the README, configuration,
  troubleshooting, architecture, development, and Wiki documentation

Existing `spectrum.json` files that follow the 1.0 schema remain compatible.

## August 14, 2026 hotfix

The release assets were refreshed with the fix from
[`81e163b`](https://github.com/ShangHTao/TaskbarAudioSpectrum/commit/81e163bfc918910de6951b16a1b8d36714373092).
On Windows 11, the per-user `SearchboxTaskbarMode` value `2` represents the
full Search box and value `3` represents Search icon and label. The previous
mapping reversed these modes, hiding the spectrum from the full box and
rendering a malformed spectrum in the narrow button.

## Downloads

- `TaskbarAudioSpectrum-v1.1.0-win64.zip` - complete portable standalone package
- `TaskbarAudioSpectrum.exe` - standalone executable
- `taskbar-audio-spectrum.wh.cpp` - generated source for Windhawk
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` - SHA-256 checksums for the executable, ZIP, and generated
  source

GitHub releases intentionally contain no prebuilt Windhawk DLLs. Windhawk users
should install the generated `.wh.cpp` source manually or use the Windhawk
catalog version when it becomes available.

## Upgrade

Standalone users can stop the current process with
`TaskbarAudioSpectrum.exe --exit`, replace the previous folder with the 1.1.0
package, keep or restore their `spectrum.json`, and start the new executable.
Move the folder to its final location before enabling Windows startup.

Windhawk users should compile the new `taskbar-audio-spectrum.wh.cpp` or update
through Windhawk when the catalog release is available. Do not run the
standalone and Windhawk editions simultaneously.

The taskbar Search setting must be the full **Search box**. Displayed levels are
relative digital playback power, not calibrated dB SPL or dBA measurements.

See the [README](https://github.com/ShangHTao/TaskbarAudioSpectrum#readme),
[configuration reference](https://github.com/ShangHTao/TaskbarAudioSpectrum/blob/main/docs/Configuration.md),
[troubleshooting guide](https://github.com/ShangHTao/TaskbarAudioSpectrum/blob/main/docs/Troubleshooting.md),
and [Wiki](https://github.com/ShangHTao/TaskbarAudioSpectrum/wiki).
